verdicts.reason: Both throw away the original. The barrel photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail, the triangle logo is a speck at the bottom instead of sitting above the name, the torn-paper texture and a black bar float around as meaningless fragments, and the tagline is right-aligned under a centred 'Hobbs Timber', so it breaks the axis. A spreads those fragments over the lower half with big random gaps between them. B at least clusters them into one strip at the bottom, but it leaves huge dead space between the headline, the tagline and that cluster.
